shortDescription: Configure authentication flows in Keycloak in an idempotent and safe manner.

options.name: alias
options.description: The name of the authentication flow.

options.name: auth_client_id
options.description: OpenID Connect C(client_id) to authenticate to the API with.

options.name: auth_client_secret
options.description: Client Secret to use in conjunction with O(auth_client_id) (if required).

options.name: auth_password
options.description: Password to authenticate for API access with.

options.name: auth_realm
options.description: Keycloak realm name to authenticate to for API access.

options.name: auth_username
options.description: Username to authenticate for API access with.

options.name: authenticationExecutions
options.description: The desired execution configuration for the flow. Executions at root level.

options.name: connection_timeout
options.description: Controls the HTTP connections timeout period (in seconds) to Keycloak API.

options.name: description
options.description: A human-readable description of the flow.

options.name: force_temporary_swap_flow_deletion
options.description: If C(true), any pre-existing temporary swap flow (identified by the original alias plus O(temporary_swap_flow_suffix)) is deleted before the Safe Swap procedure begins. Set this to C(false) to cause the module to fail instead of silently removing a pre-existing temporary flow, for example to avoid accidental data loss after an interrupted run.

options.name: providerId
options.description: The C(providerId) for the new flow.

options.name: realm
options.description: The name of the realm in which the authentication flow resides.

options.name: refresh_token
options.description: Authentication refresh token for Keycloak API.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the authentication flow should exist or not.

options.name: temporary_swap_flow_suffix
options.description: The suffix appended to the alias of the temporary flow created during a Safe Swap update. The temporary flow exists only for the duration of the swap procedure and is renamed to the original alias once all bindings have been successfully transferred.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Verify TLS certificates (do not disable this in production).
